title: A fact tied to the drawings: in the pharmaceutical section, labels of jars and labels of plant parts are written differently on the same page
statement: Every fact on the record is measured from the text alone, and a procedure fitted on public pages can copy any of them (a drifting line chain meets 17 of 17 on the practice split). The Zandbergen-Landini transliteration already records what each label stands beside: locus subtypes c (container), f (plant fragment), n (nymph), t (tube), s (star), z (zodiac) and others. A procedure that writes text cannot know which slot on a hidden page sits beside a jar and which beside a root, so a dependence of the label word on the drawn object, within a page, is a fact no text-only generator reaches without being told the layout. Measured on all public pages, certain label words only, with subtypes shuffled among the labels of the same page (199 shuffles): pharmaceutical section, container (36 words) against plant fragment (205): MI of the first glyph with the object 0.081 bits (p = 0.01), last glyph 0.098 (p = 0.005), length 0.071 (p = 0.01), first two glyphs 0.168 (p = 0.045). Biological section, nymph (64) against tube (56): nothing (p 0.18 to 0.76). Astronomical section, star (84) against unmarked (63): first two glyphs 0.452 (p = 0.015), last glyph p = 0.05, first glyph and length not significant. To do: (1) a code change letting context_mi take by: label_type (the ZL locus subtype) and a null shuffle_label_types_within_page; (2) before registering, a power check on hidden-sized samples of public pages, since a sample of pages holds only a few pharmaceutical pages and the effect may not reach p = 0.05 there; if it does not, scope it to section P and say so, or register it only as a generator target in a model rather than as a fact; (3) a fact attack with labels laid in by the scorer's line cut, to check that the attack format cannot copy it by construction. Not evidence of language: a scribe filling jar and root labels from two different word tables would produce it. It is evidence that the word written depends on what is drawn, the property anchors need.
check: A code: pull request adding context_mi by label_type and a within-page label-type shuffle, then a fact.json scoped to labels with that null, with the hidden-sized power check reported in its source note.
